narrative:
Jefferson County has 42,917 registered voters, with 20.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 18.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 53.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 35.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.0% of registrants.
